authorization: Current user requested review and additional experiments; no new markets, forecasts, causal designs or outcome-driven searches.
scope: same 2020-2025 successful EUA EU/DE/PL reported-field association
A_equals_B_in_previous_data: check; never count as separate evidence

control_ladder: original FE plus logV logN logR logS
analyses.effect_size: beta, residual correlation theta, partial R2; observed within-control x interquartile difference beta*IQR(rx) reported on response scale, no causal interpretation
influence: leave each single observation: exact OLS deletion formula
omit top ceil(.01*n) Cook-distance rows once, diagnostics only; all-data estimate remains main
analyses.temporal: 2020-2022 versus 2023-2025 split from pre-existing report; fit all nuisance slopes separately, compare beta and theta; no causal break attribution
analyses.yearly: descriptive estimates only; no six-independent-studies claim
analyses.projects: EU/DE/PL separate nuisance controls and own month FE, no independent-market claim

bootstrap.algorithm: noncircular contiguous calendar month blocks; keep original month FE; whole month multiplicity weights
bootstrap.period_sampling: independently resample within each original 36-month half; joint projects within months; shared across A,C
bootstrap.period_primary: beta_late_minus_beta_early; 97.5% pointwise percentile CIs for each of two transforms as Bonferroni 95% family sensitivity; bootstrap is approximate and exploratory
bootstrap.period_secondary: theta contrast descriptive 95% interval, no extra discovery counting
bootstrap.failed_draw: record; never redraw to success; inferential interpretation only if >=95% planned draws valid

decision_rules: no guaranteed CAS3 threshold; distinguish technical credibility and contribution
retain positive association only to extent all-data and sensitivities support
heterogeneity may restrict a universal claim even if each subgroup is positive
influence removal is not cleaned main result
weak or inconclusive outcomes do not authorize further searches
ddof or absent micro procurement data alone is not a veto for reported-field association
